solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: On appeal, this could prove tedious

parts.note: re means on or concerning, as in business letters
a petition is a formal appeal or request

explanation.surface: Someone warns that taking a case to appeal could be a long, boring business.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is a description rather than a synonym: saying the same thing again and again is what makes things tedious.
explanation.definitionFit: Saying or doing the same thing over and over is a classic cause of boredom, so it could prove tedious.

clue.text: Cabinetmaker's action — one that ensures new deal?

definitions.meaning: a prime minister makes a cabinet by moving ministers around between jobs
mixing the cards again guarantees a fresh hand is dealt

explanation.surface: A furniture maker's action, and a promise of a new deal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cabinetmaker' looks like a carpenter but is a prime minister forming a government.
explanation.definitionFit: Both a ministerial shake-up and remixing a pack of cards are called by this name.

clue.text: Letters from Nepali centrally displaying Chinese symbol

wordplay.reading: P, A: the centre of NEPALI, one letter coupled with the other

parts.note: the two letters standing in the middle of the six-letter word Nepali, named one after the other

explanation.surface: A Nepali text whose middle shows a Chinese character.
explanation.walkthrough: The middle letters of Nepali are P and A; written out as that phrase they spell the answer. 'displaying' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: The giant black-and-white bear is China's national emblem, a symbol of the country.

clue.text: Corps of soldiers love my job getting harder, permanently

parts.note: the RM, the Royal Marines, a corps of soldiers
love is zero in tennis, O
the setter's job is setting crosswords

explanation.surface: A soldier says his corps, his love and his job are toughening him for good.
explanation.walkthrough: 'my' is the setter speaking, so 'my job' is setting.
explanation.definitionFit: Such plastics harden irreversibly when heated and cannot be remelted.

clue.text: Drums, monkey stopping to beat one

indicators.note: stopping means plugging a gap, so the monkey is placed inside

parts.note: to tan someone's hide is to beat them
a little monkey, a mischievous child, is an imp
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A drummer monkey stops to beat a drum.
explanation.definitionFit: Kettledrums in an orchestra are known collectively by this Italian name.

clue.text: Round figure doctor holds up in window, perhaps

parts.note: O is round in shape

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the letters read from bottom to top, backwards
holds means the doctor contains the number

parts.note: GP is a general practitioner
nine is a figure, a number

explanation.surface: A doctor holds up a round figure in the window.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' reverses GNINEP to give PENING after O.
explanation.definitionFit: A window is one kind of gap or aperture in a wall, an example of the answer.

clue.text: Get front of Turkish rug

indicators.note: the front of a word is its first letter, so take the opening letter of Turkish

parts.note: rug is slang for a wig or toupee

explanation.surface: An instruction to buy the front part of a Turkish carpet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rug' looks like a carpet but is slang for a hairpiece.
explanation.definitionFit: To twig is informal British usage for understanding something suddenly, just as 'get it' means grasp it.

clue.text: Club, very familiar music venue

parts.note: a wood is a type of golf club
stock means standard or commonplace, as in a stock phrase

explanation.surface: A club that knows a music venue very well.
explanation.definitionFit: The 1969 festival in New York State is the most famous rock concert site of all.

clue.text: Company hasn't time to make suppositions

indicators.note: hasn't means the time letter is missing from the company word

parts.note: company in the sense of visitors one has round

explanation.surface: A firm is short of time to make assumptions.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Company' looks like a firm but means guests; 'to' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To speculate or form an opinion without full evidence is to surmise.

clue.text: Ray in student group returning smile

indicators.note: returning means the letters of the student body's abbreviation are read backwards

parts.note: the NUS is the National Union of Students in Britain
to beam is to smile broadly

explanation.surface: A man named Ray, back among his student friends, flashes a grin.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Ray' poses as a man's name but is the beam of light.
explanation.definitionFit: A shaft of light from our star is a ray of sunshine.

clue.text: Abridged great book, for example

indicators.note: abridged means shortened, so the word for great loses its final letter

parts.note: epic means great or heroic in scale
a tome is a large book

explanation.surface: A shortened version of a great book is offered as a sample.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Abridged great book' reads as one phrase, but 'Abridged' cuts only the adjective, and 'for' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: The perfect embodiment or typical instance of something is called its epitome.

clue.text: Doomed liberal America almost past saving

indicators.note: doomed means ruined or wrecked, so the letters are broken up and rearranged
almost means the last letter of the country is dropped

explanation.surface: A pundit declares liberal America lost beyond rescue.
explanation.walkthrough: Shuffle LIBERAL plus AMERIC.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that can never be recovered or redeemed is beyond rescue.

clue.text: Strip protection from team without right back

indicators.note: back means the whole assembled string is read in reverse order
without in its old sense of outside, so the team's letters surround the right

parts.note: Man U is short for Manchester United, the football team

explanation.surface: A sports team without its right back is left exposed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Right back' looks like a football position; 'right' gives R and 'back' reverses everything.
explanation.definitionFit: To disarm someone is to take away their weapons, their means of protection.

clue.text: Area cultivated is doubled, part for farmers

indicators.note: cultivated means worked over, so the letters are dug and rearranged
doubled means the little word is written out twice

explanation.surface: Land under cultivation has doubled, partly to suit the farmers.
explanation.walkthrough: Shuffle ISIS (from 'is doubled') with PART, after A.
explanation.definitionFit: Beekeepers are a kind of farmer, raising bees in hives for honey.

clue.text: Swimmers after water sport gathering in training place

indicators.note: after puts the swimmers' word behind the other part
gathering means the angling word collects the little word inside it

parts.note: fishing is a sport done on water
a school is a group of fish swimming together

explanation.surface: Swimmers gather after the water sports at the training pool.
explanation.walkthrough: A finishing school taught upper-class girls social graces.
explanation.definitionFit: Such a school is a place where young people were trained in etiquette and polish.

clue.text: King follows his noble, barking Great Dane

indicators.note: follows means the king's letter comes after the rest
barking means mad, so the letters go crazy and are rearranged

parts.note: R is the abbreviation for king, from rex

explanation.surface: A king trails his noble Great Dane, which is barking.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Great Dane' looks like a dog, which suits 'barking', but means a famous Danish person.
explanation.definitionFit: The Danish physicist who modelled the atom won a Nobel Prize, a great Dane indeed.

clue.text: Departed before improvement from one side?

indicators.note: before means the first piece comes ahead of the second

parts.note: the late someone is someone departed, dead
a rally is a recovery or improvement, as in share prices

explanation.surface: Someone left just before things improved.
explanation.definitionFit: Moving sideways rather than forwards is done in a sideways manner.

clue.text: Warmer kind of blue and white escort's coat

parts.note: electric blue is a bright shade of blue
blank means white or unmarked, like a blank page

indicators.note: a coat is the outside layer, so take the outer letters of escort

explanation.surface: A tailor describes a warmer garment: an escort's coat in blue and white.
explanation.walkthrough: 'and' is a link joining the pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: A bed heater worked by mains power is a device for warming someone in bed.

clue.text: This person's appealing on record for revered architect

parts.note: this person, the setter, is: I am, shortened
hot means attractive or appealing
an EP is an extended-play record

explanation.surface: The setter claims to be attractive on record to a revered architect.
explanation.definitionFit: The ancient Egyptian builder of the step pyramid was later worshipped as a god.

clue.text: Least idle, yet nap endlessly

indicators.note: endlessly means each of the two words loses its last letter

parts.note: yet means but, and a nap is a siesta, taken one after the other

explanation.surface: Someone wants to be busy, yet craves a never-ending snooze.
explanation.walkthrough: 'endlessly' applies to both words before it: each loses its last letter.
explanation.definitionFit: The most occupied person is the least idle, the superlative of occupied.

clue.text: Chat about small sources of illumination

indicators.note: about means the chat word goes round the outside of the other

parts.note: gas is informal for idle talk or chatter
slight means small or minor

explanation.surface: Talk about tiny lamps.
explanation.walkthrough: 'small' looks as if it qualifies the lights, but it is a piece of wordplay held inside the chat word.
explanation.definitionFit: Lamps burning coal gas were the main street and home lighting of the Victorian era.

clue.text: Gold piece comes first for Florida resident, say

indicators.note: comes first means the gun word is placed ahead of the gold

parts.note: a piece is slang for a gun, as is gat
or is gold in heraldry

explanation.surface: Gold coins come first for a Florida retiree.
explanation.definitionFit: The alligator, informally shortened, lives in Florida's swamps, an example of a local.

clue.text: Note monarch from the east is no lone wolf

parts.note: mi is the third note of the sol-fa scale

indicators.note: from the east in an across clue means read right to left, so backwards

parts.note: rex is Latin for king

explanation.surface: A notice says a king from the east is not a solitary figure.
explanation.definitionFit: A sociable person who mingles easily at parties is the opposite of a loner.

clue.text: African's vote — I'm surprised about it

parts.note: an X is the mark made on a ballot paper

indicators.note: about means the exclamation is turned round

parts.note: oh is an exclamation of surprise
it is sex appeal, SA

explanation.surface: An African casts a vote and exclaims in surprise at it.
explanation.walkthrough: 's is 'has' or 'is' as a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A member of a Bantu people of South Africa's Eastern Cape belongs to this group.

clue.text: Leaders of town hall are supposed to provide idea

indicators.note: leaders are the first letters of the following words

parts.note: ought means are supposed to, as in 'you ought to go'

explanation.surface: Town hall leaders are expected to come up with an idea.
explanation.definitionFit: A notion or plan formed in the mind is an idea.

clue.text: Involve relative wearing green the wrong way

indicators.note: wearing means the colour is put on around the relative, so it contains him
the wrong way means the colour word is reversed

parts.note: lime is a shade of green
bro is short for brother, a relative

explanation.surface: A relative is caught up wearing green clothes put on back to front.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the wrong way' turns the colour into EMIL before it goes round the relative.
explanation.definitionFit: To drag someone into a dispute or difficulty is to involve them in it.

clue.text: Somewhat nearer a reddish pink?

indicators.note: Somewhat says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A colour description: something moving closer to a reddish pink.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags that pink means undercooked meat, not a colour.
explanation.definitionFit: Steak cooked lightly is still pink inside, which is what a diner means by rare.

clue.text: A drug man, roughly, with tips for remedy?

definitions.text: A drug man, roughly, with tips for remedy?

parts.note: pot is slang for cannabis
he is a pronoun for a man
ca, short for circa, means roughly or about

indicators.note: tips are the two ends, so take the first and last letters of remedy

explanation.surface: A drug dealer of sorts, armed with advice on cures.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is both definition and wordplay: an old-time pharmacist was a drug man giving tips on remedies.
explanation.definitionFit: Historically a druggist who prepared and sold medicines was known by this name.
